scripts.setup:api: pnpm setup:vendor && cd apps/api && uv sync
scripts.setup:desktop: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm setup:api && pnpm build:deps
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.build:deps: cd apps/web && node scripts/setup-ffmpeg.js && cd ../api && uv run python build.py
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm build:deps && pnpm --dir apps/web tauri build
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && uv run python -m pytest
